{
  "nodes": [
    { "id": "start", "type": "ellipse", "text": "Start", "x": 300, "y": 40, "width": 240, "height": 70 },
    { "id": "signup_page", "type": "rectangle", "text": "Open signup page", "x": 300, "y": 190, "width": 240, "height": 70 },
    { "id": "login", "type": "ellipse", "text": "Log in", "x": 780, "y": 190, "width": 200, "height": 70 },
    { "id": "enter_credentials", "type": "rectangle", "text": "Enter email and password", "x": 300, "y": 340, "width": 240, "height": 70 },
    { "id": "validate", "type": "diamond", "text": "Input valid?", "x": 300, "y": 490, "width": 240, "height": 90 },
    { "id": "show_error", "type": "rectangle", "text": "Show error message", "x": 0, "y": 490, "width": 200, "height": 70 },
    { "id": "send_verification", "type": "rectangle", "text": "Send verification email", "x": 300, "y": 660, "width": 240, "height": 70 },
    { "id": "verified", "type": "diamond", "text": "Email verified?", "x": 300, "y": 810, "width": 240, "height": 90 },
    { "id": "resend", "type": "rectangle", "text": "Resend verification email", "x": 700, "y": 810, "width": 220, "height": 70 },
    { "id": "profile", "type": "rectangle", "text": "Complete user profile", "x": 300, "y": 980, "width": 240, "height": 70 },
    { "id": "create_account", "type": "rectangle", "text": "Create account", "x": 300, "y": 1130, "width": 240, "height": 70 },
    { "id": "success", "type": "ellipse", "text": "Signup complete", "x": 300, "y": 1280, "width": 240, "height": 70 }
  ],
  "edges": [
    { "from": "start", "to": "signup_page", "label": "Go" },
    { "from": "signup_page", "to": "login", "label": "Existing" },
    { "from": "signup_page", "to": "enter_credentials", "label": "New" },
    { "from": "enter_credentials", "to": "validate", "label": "Submit" },
    { "from": "validate", "to": "show_error", "label": "No" },
    { "from": "show_error", "to": "enter_credentials", "label": "Retry" },
    { "from": "validate", "to": "send_verification", "label": "Yes" },
    { "from": "send_verification", "to": "verified", "label": "Send" },
    { "from": "verified", "to": "resend", "label": "No" },
    { "from": "resend", "to": "send_verification", "label": "Retry" },
    { "from": "verified", "to": "profile", "label": "Yes" },
    { "from": "profile", "to": "create_account", "label": "Next" },
    { "from": "create_account", "to": "success", "label": "Done" }
  ]
